```{python}
# | label: simulate-processes

import pprint
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objs as go
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde

from inf_bp_texts.inference import fit_birth_death_process
from inf_bp_texts.simulation import simulate_birth_death_process
from inf_bp_texts.visualization import save_figure

# Import professional styling configuration from central plotting module
from inf_bp_texts.visualization.plotting import (
    apply_professional_styling,
    font_config,
    title_font_config,
    plot_bgcolor,
    paper_bgcolor,
    gridcolor,
    my_blue,
    my_cyan,
    my_green,
    my_yellow,
    my_red,
    my_violet,
    my_gray,
    ptolqual,
)

color_palette = ptolqual

# Create directory for saving figures
figures_dir = Path("figures")
figures_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# Parameters for simulation
num_sims = 1000
birth_rate = 0.005
death_rate = birth_rate - 0.004
time_span = 1500
seed = 42

print(f"🎲 Generate {num_sims} birth-death process simulations...")
print(f"   Birth rate: {birth_rate}")
print(f"   Death rate: {death_rate}")
print(f"   Time span: {time_span} years")
print("=" * 60)

simulated_processes = []
for i in range(num_sims):
    sim = simulate_birth_death_process(
        birth_rate=birth_rate,
        death_rate=death_rate,
        max_time=time_span,
        random_seed=seed + i,  # ensure different random streams
    )
    simulated_processes.append(sim)

# Show some sample results
print(f"\n📋 Sample simulation results:")
for i in range(min(5, len(simulated_processes))):
    sim = simulated_processes[i]
    print(
        f"   Simulation {i + 1}: {len(sim)} manuscripts, "
        f"age range: {sim['age'].min():.0f}-{sim['age'].max():.0f} years"
    )
```

Derivative of the log-likehoods

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP_n}{d\lambda} = \frac{\mu  \left(\mu -\mu  n+\lambda  (n-\mu  t+1)+\lambda ^2 t\right)+e^{t (\lambda -\mu )} (n (\lambda -\mu ) (\lambda  t (\lambda -\mu )-\mu )-\mu  (3 \lambda +\mu ))+\lambda  e^{2 t (\lambda -\mu )} (2 \mu +\lambda  t (\mu -\lambda ))}{\lambda  (\lambda -\mu ) \left(e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu \right)}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP_n}{d\mu} = \frac{\lambda ^2 t e^{t (\lambda -\mu )} \left(e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-n\right)-\lambda  \left(-(2 \mu  n t+n+3) e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}+n+(\mu  t+2) e^{2 t (\lambda -\mu )}+\mu  t+1\right)-\mu  \left((\mu  n t+n-1) e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-n-\mu  t+1\right)}{(\lambda -\mu ) \left(e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu \right)}
\end{equation}

Derivation of the derivative of the ages

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP(age)}{d\lambda} = \frac{(\lambda  t-1) e^{\mu  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}-(\lambda  t+\lambda  T-1) e^{\mu  t+2 T (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu  T e^{\lambda  t}+2 \mu  T e^{\lambda  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}}{\left(e^{T (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{\mu  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu  e^{\lambda  t}\right)}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP(age)}{d\mu} = \frac{\lambda  T e^{\mu  t+2 T (\lambda -\mu )}+e^{\lambda  t} (\mu  (-t)+\mu  T+1)+(\mu  t-2 \mu  T-1) e^{\lambda  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}}{\left(e^{T (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{\mu  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu  e^{\lambda  t}\right)}
\end{equation}

```{python}
# | eval: true
# | label: fit-models

print(f"🔬 Fit birth-death models to {len(simulated_processes)} simulated processes...")
print("=" * 60)

fitted_models = []
successful_fits = 0
failed_fits = 0

for i, sim in enumerate(simulated_processes):
    sim = sim[sim["age"].notnull()]
    if len(sim) > 0:
        try:
            ages = sim["age"].values
            observation_time = time_span
            # If you want to use counts, you could add: counts = sim.get("count", None)
            model = fit_birth_death_process(
                ages=ages,
                observation_time=observation_time,
                counts=None,  # or provide counts if available
                method="L-BFGS-B",
                initial_params=None,
            )
            fitted_models.append(model)
            if model is not None and model.get("success", False):
                successful_fits += 1
            else:
                failed_fits += 1
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️  Model {i + 1} failed: {str(e)[:50]}...")
            fitted_models.append(None)
            failed_fits += 1
    else:
        fitted_models.append(None)
        failed_fits += 1

print(f"   Total models: {len(simulated_processes)}")
print(f"   Successful fits: {successful_fits}")
print(f"   Failed fits: {failed_fits}")
print(f"   Success rate: {(successful_fits / len(simulated_processes) * 100):.1f}%")
```

```{python}
# | label: summary-statistics

print("📊 Compute summary statistics...")

# Collect birth and death rates from fitted models
birth_rates = [
    m["birth_rate"] for m in fitted_models if m is not None and m.get("success", False)
]
death_rates = [
    m["death_rate"] for m in fitted_models if m is not None and m.get("success", False)
]

print(
    f"   Successfully extracted {len(birth_rates)} birth rates and {len(death_rates)} death rates"
)

summary_stats = {
    "Parameter": ["Birth Rate", "Death Rate"],
    "True Value": [birth_rate, death_rate],
    "Mean": [np.mean(birth_rates), np.mean(death_rates)],
    "Median": [np.median(birth_rates), np.median(death_rates)],
    "Std": [np.std(birth_rates), np.std(death_rates)],
    "Min": [np.min(birth_rates), np.min(death_rates)],
    "Max": [np.max(birth_rates), np.max(death_rates)],
    "25%": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 25), np.percentile(death_rates, 25)],
    "75%": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 75), np.percentile(death_rates, 75)],
}

stats_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_stats)
print("\n📈 Parameter Estimation Summary:")
print("=" * 60)
print(stats_df.to_string(index=False, float_format="%.6f"))
```

```{python}
# | label: plot-bd-inference

print("📈 Generate parameter estimation density plots...")

if len(birth_rates) > 1:
    birth_kde = gaussian_kde(birth_rates)
    x_birth = np.linspace(
        min(birth_rates), min([max(birth_rates), 10 * birth_rate]), 100
    )
    fig_birth = go.Figure()
    fig_birth.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=x_birth,
            y=birth_kde(x_birth),
            mode="lines",
            name="Birth Rate Density",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[0]),
        )
    )
    # Add vertical line for true birth_rate
    fig_birth.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[birth_rate, birth_rate],
            y=[0, max(birth_kde(x_birth))],
            mode="lines",
            name="True Birth Rate",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[1], dash="dash"),
        )
    )
    fig_birth = apply_professional_styling(
        fig_birth, "Density of Fitted Birth Rates", "Birth Rate", "Density"
    )
    fig_birth.show()

    # Save the figure
    save_figure(fig_birth, "mv_birth_rate_density", width=550, height=300)
else:
    print("   ⚠️  Not enough fitted models to plot birth rate density.")

if len(death_rates) > 1:
    death_kde = gaussian_kde(death_rates)
    x_death = np.linspace(
        min(death_rates), min([max(death_rates), 10 * death_rate]), 100
    )
    fig_death = go.Figure()
    fig_death.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=x_death,
            y=death_kde(x_death),
            mode="lines",
            name="Death Rate Density",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[0]),
        )
    )
    # Add vertical line for true death_rate
    fig_death.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[death_rate, death_rate],
            y=[0, max(death_kde(x_death))],
            mode="lines",
            name="True Death Rate",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[1], dash="dash"),
        )
    )
    fig_death = apply_professional_styling(
        fig_death, "Density of Fitted Death Rates", "Death Rate", "Density"
    )
    fig_death.show()

    # Save the figure
    save_figure(fig_death, "mv_death_rate_density", width=550, height=300)
else:
    print("   ⚠️  Not enough fitted models to plot death rate density.")
```

```{python}
# | label: joint-density-plot

print("\n🎯 Create 2D joint density plot...")

if len(birth_rates) > 1 and len(death_rates) > 1:
    xy = np.vstack([birth_rates, death_rates])
    kde = gaussian_kde(xy)
    x_grid = np.linspace(min(birth_rates), 2 * birth_rate, 100)
    y_grid = np.linspace(min(death_rates), 3 * death_rate, 100)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_grid, y_grid)
    positions = np.vstack([X.ravel(), Y.ravel()])
    Z = kde(positions).reshape(X.shape)
    fig_joint = go.Figure(
        data=go.Contour(
            x=x_grid,
            y=y_grid,
            z=Z,
            colorscale="Viridis",
            contours=dict(showlabels=True),
            colorbar=dict(title="Density"),
        )
    )
    fig_joint.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[birth_rate],
            y=[death_rate],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[1], size=8, symbol="circle"),
            name="True Value",
        )
    )
    fig_joint = apply_professional_styling(
        fig_joint,
        "2D Density of Fitted Birth and Death Rates",
        "Birth Rate",
        "Death Rate",
    )
    fig_joint.update_layout(showlegend=True)
    fig_joint.show()

    # Save the figure
    save_figure(fig_joint, "mv_joint_density_rates", width=550, height=400)
else:
    print("   ⚠️  Not enough fitted models for joint density plot.")
```

```{python}
# | label: box-plots

import plotly.graph_objs as go

# Prepare data for box plot
box_data = [
    birth_rates,
    death_rates,
]

labels = ["MLE Birth Rates", "MLE Death Rates"]
true_values = [birth_rate, death_rate]
means = [np.mean(birth_rates), np.mean(death_rates)]
medians = [np.median(birth_rates), np.median(death_rates)]

fig_box = go.Figure()

for i, data in enumerate(box_data):
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Box(
            y=data,
            name=labels[i],
            boxmean=True,
            boxpoints="outliers",
            marker_color=ptolqual[0],
        )
    )
    # Add true value
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[true_values[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[1], size=8, symbol="circle"),
            name="True",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )
    # Add sample mean
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[means[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[2], size=10, symbol="circle"),
            name="Mean",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )
    # Add sample median
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[medians[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color=ptolqual[3], size=10, symbol="square"),
            name="Median",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )

fig_box = apply_professional_styling(
    fig_box, "Box Plot of Fitted Birth and Death Rates", "Parameter", "Rate"
)
# Override showlegend for box plot
fig_box.update_layout(showlegend=True)
fig_box.show()

# Save the figure
save_figure(fig_box, "mv_parameter_boxplots", width=550, height=350)
```
